title: Does PH equal PSPACE?
formal: Is every language decidable in polynomial space in some finite level of the polynomial hierarchy?
context:
Distinct from PH non-collapse: an infinite hierarchy cannot equal PSPACE, but PH≠PSPACE does not assert that every hierarchy level is strict.

This question was found through Wikipedia and compared individually with the existing candidate and archived records. The linked literature provides definitions and background; this import is not a completed research-card review.
why: Separates unbounded polynomial-space computation from a bounded number of polynomial-time alternations.
